paragraphs.text: Greta Gorunn is a first-year dwarf student at Lorehold College in Strixhaven University. Loud, cheerful, and endlessly energetic, she is a well-known presence on campus both for her physical strength and her irreverent sense of humor.

Greta is a boisterous figure whose booming laughter often announces her arrival long before she's seen. Widely regarded as a golden-hearted troublemaker, she openly detests studying and has received frequent warnings from librarians due to her loud behavior — something she finds endlessly amusing.

A proud and dedicated member of the Strixhaven Iron-Lifters Society, Greta has already begun breaking long-standing campus records in powerlifting and weightlifting. When not training, she's typically found carousing at Bow's End Tavern or helping with physical labor at Strixhaven Stadium , where she works as an equipment assistant. She views the job as getting paid to work out — an arrangement she enjoys immensely.

Despite her carefree nature, Greta has a strong sense of loyalty and family. She regularly writes to her older brother, Grog , whom she deeply misses. Her friendships are equally solid; those close to her can always rely on her strength and support. Conversely, those who annoy her may find themselves inconvenienced by mysteriously relocated heavy objects.
